Terraza 362 | Villa del Mar, Palmilla

A home filled with tranquility and beautiful ocean views.

Located in Villa del Mar, Palmilla, Terraza 362 is a residence designed for slowing down, reconnecting, and enjoying the beauty of Los Cabos.

Featuring 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 1 powder room, and 3,198 sq. ft. of living space, this inviting home blends rustic finishes with a warm, relaxed atmosphere. Its beautiful ocean views and serene surroundings create the perfect setting to unwind, recharge, and embrace a slower pace of life.

Discover a home where comfort meets the tranquility of coastal living.
